Run **your own copy** of Bryce 3D (1997, Windows edition) as a Mac app on Apple Silicon. Nothing from Bryce is included: you need your CD (or an image of it) and your serial number.

**Install**

1. Download **Bryce-3D.dmg** below, open it and drag **Bryce 3D** to **Applications**.
2. Open Bryce 3D. The first time, macOS may say it can't verify the app: click **Done**, open **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, and click **Open Anyway** next to "Bryce 3D".
3. Choose your Bryce 3D CD image. Bryce is set up in a few seconds and asks for your name and serial number once (paste the serial with Ctrl+V).

Needs an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 14 or later and about 4 GB of free space. Rosetta is not used. Full instructions: see the README.

**Licenses:** the app contains a small Linux system (Ubuntu packages, Hangover Wine, FEX). `SOURCES.md` lists every package with links to its source code and includes the written offer for GPL/LGPL source; `packages.tsv` is the same list in machine-readable form.
